reference_provenance.usage: engineering reference for strict single-policy on-policy PPO and hierarchical gate/amount probability semantics only; no LRMB runtime dependency

environment.training_water_availability: W100 upper bound only; the learned policy minimizes actual use below this cap

policy.hierarchical_action: Bernoulli irrigation gate plus active-only tanh-Gaussian amount_fraction
policy.behavior_probability_contract: PPO likelihood ratios use the sampled gate and pre-tanh amount latent. Environment projection/canonicalization never replaces the sampled behavior action in the PPO log-probability.

reward.name: trajectory_feasibility_ranked_scalar_surrogate
reward.terminal_violation_penalty: 0 if R >= eta else -(1 + eta - R)
reward.trajectory_ranking_property: For a single trajectory, every target-feasible episode has return in [-1,0] and every target-infeasible episode has return below -1.
reward.distribution_level_caveat: PPO maximizes expected scalar return, so performance across weather years can compensate in expectation. This surrogate does not impose hard distribution-level feasibility and does not guarantee the LCVaR constraint.
reward.not_claimed_as: LCVaR optimization; PPO remains a scalar expected-return baseline and formal risk is evaluated separately using Risk Contract v1

optimizer.name: Adam
optimizer.gae_rationale: The 125-day task has terminal yield protection as its main delayed signal; lambda=1 preserves undiscounted complete-episode credit assignment rather than exponentially attenuating the terminal consequence for early-season actions.

interaction_budget.fairness_rule: Every learned comparator, including RCWA-RL and any constrained learned baseline, must receive the same maximum environment-training interaction budget per seed. Any extra DSSAT trajectory used to update learned parameters, risk estimators, dual variables or auxiliary trainable modules counts toward this budget.
interaction_budget.validation_candidate_budget_rule: Every learned comparator uses the same candidate-checkpoint cadence and the same 15-cell validation budget per candidate.

training.seed_selection: forbidden; all five seeds remain independent replicates
training.recovery_checkpoint_semantics: Recovery checkpoints exist only for exact restart and are never eligible for model selection unless the update also lies on the frozen candidate cadence.
training.candidate_checkpoint_semantics: Only updates 10,20,...,200 are scientific checkpoint-selection candidates.

validation.selection: one checkpoint per training seed using awm-learned-method-evaluation-v1

change_rule: Any change to PPO architecture, reward surrogate, optimizer hyperparameters, scheduler, seeds, normalization, interaction budget, checkpoint cadence or validation/final-test action mode after formal PPO training begins requires a new PPO protocol version.
